original_benchmark.notes: EmbodiedLab 0.2.1, dev split, interface level T0 (raw control). 30 determination and 5 optimization experiments. The original trial runner hands the rendered workspace to any coding agent; it ships no agent of its own.
Not adapted: T1 adds SAM3 segmentation and cuRobo motion planning, which run as separate GPU services outside the task container.

harbor_adapter.notes: One dev instance per experiment, the instance whose recorded successful run is the oracle. truss_bridge, lens_focal and optical_relay are not yet included, until their oracle replays are validated (README, Notes & Caveats). Parity has not run yet; None parity-agent entries mean no experiments.
